name: חֵנָדָד
summary: Read as חֵן “favour” joined to Hadad, the name of the Aramean god known from Ben-hadad and Hadad-rimmon. Borne by the head of a Levite family whose sons oversaw the work on the house of God at the return (Ezr 3:9) and sealed the covenant (Neh 10:10), and by the fathers of Bavvai and Binnui, who repaired the wall (Neh 3:18, 24).

evidence.note: “The sons of Henadad, their sons and their brothers the Levites”, overseeing the workmen in the house of God.
Hadad as a divine name in “Hadad-rimmon”.
Ben-hadad, “son of Hadad”, king of Aram.

note: Takes h.dz.am (4 tokens). The division חֵן + הֲדַד is a reading of the form; no verse explains the name, and why a Levite family bore an Aramean god's name is not said.
